eq.piano: High-pass gently around the low mids if the 808 needs room, but keep enough body for emotion.
eq.bell: Tame the sharp upper-mid spike if the attack starts poking through the vocal range.
eq.808: Keep the sub fundamental clear and avoid boosting the same zone as the kick.

reverb.dark: Use a shorter, darker plate or room so the melody stays intimate.
reverb.wide: Use a filtered stereo reverb on the support layer instead of drowning the lead itself.

masking: If piano and bell share the same octave, shorten the bell or move it up an octave.
Keep one lead source narrow in the center and let supporting ambience provide width.
Leave transient priority to the part that carries the hook.
